Thanks again for agreeing to move forward with the Redwood POC. We want to get the kickoff scheduled and align owners, success criteria, and a short timeline so the trial has clear acceptance gates. Proposed agenda for the kickoff (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (AE / SE / Customer leads)
- High-level POC scope and success criteria (what 'good' looks like)
- Timeline, milestones, and dependencies (network, test data, credentials)
- Pre-kickoff checklist / next steps (attachments)

Availability: we have SE coverage (Dylan) and CS (Naomi) next week most mornings PST and afternoons ET. Suggested slots:
- Tue 2026-11-24 15:00 ET / 12:00 PT
- Wed 2026-11-25 11:00 ET / 08:00 PT
- Thu 2026-11-26 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.pdf (draft), integration-checklist.xlsx (sample env checklist). Please confirm which slot works and who from Acme will attend (engineering, security/compliance, procurement). Once we confirm I'll send a calendar invite and include the short pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks,
